data.name: Corilagin

identifiers_status.reason: Gene and protein identifiers do not apply to the type "Drug".

data.description: Natural ellagitannin with anti-inflammatory activity that inhibits PI3K/AKT/mTOR and NF-κB signalling and restores autophagy.

page_status.reason: By design: fewer than three linked studies and not a node on the pathway map, so no page is generated. The record is still served here and in the bulk exports.

data.description_beginner: A plant compound (a tannin) found in several medicinal herbs. In lab studies it calms inflammation by blocking both PI3K/AKT/mTOR and NF-κB signalling, and it restores autophagy, the cell's recycling process.

studies.title: Corilagin attenuates osteoarthritis progression by coordinating NF-κB inhibition with PI3K/AKT/mTOR-associated autophagy restoration.
studies.authors: Zhou R; Li Jie; Chen S; Meng C; Liu Q; Huang X; You H

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.model_system: Mouse (DMM OA model); primary mouse chondrocytes
studies.finding: Corilagin restores chondrocyte autophagic flux and ECM synthesis by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/mTOR and NF-κB signalling, reducing cartilage erosion and OARSI scores in the mouse DMM osteoarthritis model.
